cohort: The study included 287 neonates admitted to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit of a tertiary care hospital.
finding: 11.8% of the neonates were diagnosed with Congenital Heart Disease, with Ventricular Septal Defect being the most common, and no significant relationship was found with gender, mode of delivery, gestational age, or neonate outcome.
mod_finding: No significant relationship was found between Congenital Heart Disease and mode of delivery.
